description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST Controller for exporting book data, handling HTTP GET requests at '/api/export-books-data' and delegating to a service to perform the export based on the current user.

classes.name: BookExportController
classes.description: A REST controller for exporting user-specific book data.

methods.name: exportBooksData
methods.description: Handles GET requests to export the books data of the current user.
